name: niro-control
description: Niro Control: the look of the desktop in one place (island, dock, search, control panel). TypeScript for the shell and the panel, Rust for the island's programs.

scripts.build: tsc -p shell/island && tsc -p shell/dock && tsc -p shell/search && tsc -p shell/emulator && tsc -p control && mkdir -p control/build/tile && cp shell/tile/layouts.js shell/tile/config.js shell/tile/windowRules.js control/build/tile/ && mkdir -p shell/search/build/shared control/build/shared && mkdir -p shell/island/build/src/shared && cp shell/shared/tokens.js shell/island/build/src/shared/ && cp shell/shared/*.js shell/search/build/shared/ && cp shell/shared/*.js control/build/shared/
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/island/*.test.js && tests/gjs/run.sh
